content.short: Up Vs. Down is a decentralized social pool game by Playnance.
content.description: Up Vs. Down is a decentralized trading game where the outcome of each round hinges on the expiry rate, calculated from the live market price of the asset at the moment the round closes. Players retain full control of their funds with complete transparency and no conflict of interest. Smart contracts enforce the game rules and verify results, providing a secure, trust-minimized mechanism that preserves fairness as participants trade on price movements. The design emphasizes autonomy and transparency, allowing users to verify round results and audit the system themselves.
